C1170.title: Mastodon Rate Limit Bypass via X-Forwarded-For Header Spoofing
C1170.summary: A vulnerability in the Mastodon social platform allows attackers to spoof IP addresses by setting the X-Forwarded-For or Client-IP HTTP headers, thereby bypassing IP-based rate limiting. This flaw can be exploited to circumvent frequency controls on login attempts, API calls, and other operations, potentially leading to brute-force attacks or resource abuse.
